purpose: Teach: 小切手/インターンシップ/本案/公言/借り入れ/呼び名/生年月日/ベーシック

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、小切手の信用を大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father really valued the trust that came with his word when we were starting out.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. A slight pause before speaking—gathering a memory. Warm regard in the voice. Steady eye contact held across generations. Not lecturing; witnessing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは学生インターンシップを早期から導入された
lines.en: Yes. He brought in student internships earlier than most companies thought to.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. A small nod in the voice. Careful, precise—not rushing through the detail. The tone of someone learning by listening to who came before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本案の前にも社員の意見を聞かれた
lines.en: And before any major decision, he'd ask the staff what they thought.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost tender. A slight lift of admiration at the end. Paced slowly—giving each detail room to land. The voice of someone who wishes he'd paid closer attention then.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営方針を社外に公言された
lines.en: He did. He was open about how the company would be run—didn't hide it from anyone.
lines.style: Careful, almost solemn. Speaking of a principle that mattered. Not proud—truthful. A slight catch, like the weight of that inheritance is settling on his shoulders.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、銀行からの借り入れ無しで成長されたぞ
lines.en: He grew the business without borrowing a single yen from the bank.
lines.style: With quiet amazement underneath. The voice of someone recalling something almost impossible to do now. Steady, but with a note of loss—not mourning, but acknowledging how much has changed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の呼び名にこだわった
lines.en: Yes. He was particular about what things were called—that mattered to him.
lines.style: A soft, almost bemused tone. Like he's just now understanding why his father cared about small words. Not defensive. Thoughtful. The pace slows on 「呼び名」—letting it breathe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の生年月日に合わせてお祝いされたぞ
lines.en: He remembered every employee's birthday and celebrated with them.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. The voice of someone recalling small kindnesses that meant everything. A gentle certainty—no embellishment needed. Slight trailing-off, like there's more unsaid about what that taught him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはベーシックな商売道を貫かれた
lines.en: Yes. He kept to the fundamentals—honest work, honest people. That was his way.
lines.style: Final, weighted with closure. Spoken like a vow or a compass bearing. No doubt in the voice. Slower pace. The certainty of someone who has lived by those principles and is now passing them forward.
